images.caption: The Dom Tower in Utrecht, the Netherlands is one of the best known landmarks of this country. This gothic tower is the highest church tower (112,5 metres/368 feet) in the Netherlands and was built between 1321 and 1382 as part of the Cathedral of St. Martin. The resolution of the original photograph is 7768*4150.

images.filename: North Sea Jazz Festival 2012 - ALOE BLACC.jpg
images.caption:
North Sea Jazz Festival 2012 - ALOE BLACC & THE GRAND SCHEME.
Aloe Blacc with Randal Fisher (saxophone); Chris Bautista (trumpet) live at the NSJ Sunday 08 July 2012. 

The North Sea Jazz Festival is an annual jazz festival held each second weekend of July in Rotterdam the Netherlands at the Ahoy venue. Founded in 1976 by Indies Dutchman Paul Acket in The Hague.
